newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates mixed on correction.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates mixed on correction.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were mixed on Friday as the yield curve corrected, traders said.
The one to two-week rates fell and the three-month to one-year rates rose.
"It was an adjustment of the yield curve. The long-end went up because people were borrowing in the longer term and placing it on the short-term," a foreign bank dealer said.
The inverted yield curve had prompted banks to adopt this strategy to take advantage of the high rate in the short-term, traders said.
Short-term rates have been higher since last week when the Central Bank raised its overnight borrowing rate to 15 percent to protect the peso from the spillover effect of Thailand's financial woes.
